body:
CORRECTION to my checkpoint after adversarially expanding finding (1): exact call/receipt validation alone is not sufficient. AttemptReceipt.rendering currently omits ProviderCall.promptTemplateVersion, params, seed, and cached even though ProviderCall/EmbeddingReceipt/AttemptReceipt equality includes them. Two separately valid EmbeddingReceipt.of values can differ only in base params (or seed/cached) yet produce the same currently rendered call fields and therefore the same AttemptReceipt digest.

Required repair should therefore use attempt/v2 and canonically render the full indexed provider call (tagged Options, cached, sorted param key/value records) plus each embedding receipt kind/items/output identity, in addition to validating exact call correspondence and isKeyConsistent. Law: same items/outputs but a base ProviderCall params mutation yields a different attempt digest; mismatched vectors remain refused. This is a receipt-format bump, not a silent v1 change.

I retract only the no-rendering-change sentence; the owned authority/failClosed/clone/baseline portions stand. receipt.scala is W3-held; I can keep the v2 marker private in AttemptReceipt to avoid touching it, or coordinate the one constant line with the holder as your continuity post directs. Chief decides placement.
